_readme: Merced College's Coursedog catalog (S411, SkySotol). The catalog sits on catalog.mccd.edu and its scripts call app.coursedog.com, which a read kept to the page's own domain never printed (run 39077970234, S409). The first read of this plan (run 39089955502) kept the vendor's calls: the program search names the school merced_colleague_ethos and catalogId QTM2GIg9kimBOfyC8Dbb, and neither page fetched a PDF while it loaded. Hartnell's catalog page fetched its PDF address from app.coursedog.com/api/v1/hartnell_colleague/pdf-reports/catalogs/<catalogId> (run 39077713662), so this read asks Merced's catalog for the same, once, robots.txt first.

outside_hosts.coursedog.com: Merced's catalog vendor: the catalog's own scripts on catalog.mccd.edu call app.coursedog.com for its program list, and the vendor's public pdf-reports call answers with the catalog PDF's address, as Hartnell's did.

questions.pdf_address: The whole-catalog PDF's address and the catalogId the catalog's scripts fetch it by.
questions.program_codes: How the program search names each program (title, code, award), to check the PDF's Title - CODE headings against.
